scope: Mechanical-only assembly repair for the frozen Stage A C2/L22 isolated-CO member. All 15 v0.2 single-point recovery jobs completed successfully, but run 31477725768 still emitted MECHANICAL_INCOMPLETE during consolidation. This controller permits only normalization of artifact directory roots before the unchanged integrity validator is rerun.

allowed_repair.rule: Locate exactly one prior C2/L22 member directory in the v0.1 recovery artifact, copy its contents into recovered/stageA/co_C2_L22, then overlay the 15 successful v0.2 single-point artifacts into that same member directory. Do not execute pw.x and do not modify any run_record, input, output, hash, energy, or scientific metadata before validation.
allowed_repair.validator: Use the unchanged v0.1 validate_and_assemble_member implementation through pbe_stage_a_recovery_v2.py with the frozen v0.2 recovery contract. COMPLETE requires all 23 bond points to pass existing return-code, JOB DONE, finite-energy, input-hash, output-hash, and bond-coordinate integrity checks.

forbidden_changes: editing archived run records, inputs, outputs, hashes, or energies

provenance.reason: Run 31477725768 completed every frozen C2/L22 single-point recovery job successfully but failed only at consolidation. The smallest safe repair is directory-root normalization and revalidation, with no recomputation and no scientific interpretation.
